profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Innovative and impact-driven software engineer with a proven track record of leading cross-platform product development, driving architectural modernization, and mentoring high-performing teams. Adept at delivering complex features across Windows, macOS, Android, and web platforms, with deep expertise in front-end architecture, cross-platform app development, and AI-integrated productivity experiences. 

Recognized for technical leadership, cross-team collaboration, and a strong commitment to inclusive team culture and engineering excellence. Fueled by a deep passion for technology and engineering, and driven by relentless technical curiosity to explore, learn, and build impactful solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the development of key Copilot features across M365 using React, including the Copilot chat interface and the M365 Admin Portal with a focus on enabling customer to get the most out of Copilot. Drove cross-functional alignment with PMs, designers, and engineering managers to scope, prioritize, and deliver complex projects on aggressive timelines. 

Served as the tech lead for projects to launch the first Remote Help web app and macOS native app. I lead the team from prototyping through release, including architectural design, compliance, and security.

Mentored and onboarded engineers who were based ground the globe with an emphasis on creating an inclusive team environment, improving team cohesion, and helping engineers grow in their technical skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Drove projects that improved the reliability of delivering localized resources to the Office apps on Android and reduced the size of language these language resources. 

Initiated and drove improvements to the Office UX on Android to improve the user experience and reduce ambiguity around dynamically downloaded languages. 

Implemented improvements to the way language resources are packaged and delivered to users on Windows. 

Contributed to the design of the localization model for Windows 10X, an announced but unreleased modernization of Windows. 

Mentored engineers as they onboarded to Office for Android.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Updated Win32 APIs to support decoupling language resources from the OS. This enabled the transition to machine translated localization in Windows.  

Created a specialized tool to quickly triage and diagnose bug and crash reports for our team. This simplified the triaging and prioritizing of incoming bugs as we made significant changes to how language resources were managed by the Windows runtime

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop new products using computer vision and mobile technologies for a Y Combinator Winter 2016 startup.  Developed a search engine and marketplace for sports photography using computer vision and cloud computing. Went to sporting events to advertise and champion our product.

company.name: Timing and Racing Around the Clock

positions.title: Mobile Developer Intern
positions.description:
Developed iOS applications that prototyped ways of using Beacon technology, an emerging technology at the time, in mobile apps.

Developed an indoor positioning system that used Wi-Fi to position users as they moved through an indoor environment.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Developed data driven web applications for internal use 

Designed the database schema, backend API, and front-end UX

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description: Developed and published an iPhone app for competitive swimmers on Apple’s App Store while in high school. It is no longer published.
